comment: ANCHOR: CIO_REGIME_LQ1317_20261108 — LQ-20261107-1317 (operator 2026-11-08 20:23 ET: "is the market right, is
the sector right, we also have the CPI ... I would expect this updated around 6 a.m. with the futures and
scripts/lib/cio_regime.py assembles ONE deterministic Regime block of six sections — market (tier, score,
breadth, confirming categories), sector (selloff + leaders/laggards by rs20), macro (the LQ-1311 buy gate,
reused not re-derived), event (the open market_event_episodes row, its baseline close and the completed
sessions since), futures (/ES, /NQ, /RTY against a dated settle) and pre-market (held-name movers) — and the
brief cites it in the bottom line. The test pins the honesty law across the three columns: a missing input
is STATED as missing, an unreadable store is never an empty store, and a futures percent with no settled
reference is never printed. The cadence test moves with it: the same registry expression now fires 08:00 ET
on trading days (38 fires/week), so the row, the allowlist entry, the health contract and this test must
agree on that number and on the unchanged 12 h longest gap.
